title: Home
seo_title: Dataq Software | IT Services, Consulting & Business Solutions
meta_description: Dataq Software is a global IT services and consulting partner. We build, run and modernize the ERP, cloud, data, AI and security systems enterprises depend on, in 40+ countries, on patented delivery platforms. SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001.

blocks.x: We build, run and modernize the systems your business depends on. Dataq Software is a global IT services and consulting firm. From ERP and cloud to data, AI and security, we take on the programs enterprises depend on — and report every result against the business metric the program was funded to move.

Dataq Software works on the estate enterprises actually run: SAP and ERP cores, enterprise data platforms and integrations, cloud infrastructure, and the AI now being layered on top of them. We advise, we build, and we run what we build. Delivery teams work onsite and offshore under one standard, managed operations run around the clock behind every program, and results are reported against the numbers agreed at the start.

Eight proprietary platforms and eight patented method families give every engagement a configured starting point, so your budget goes to the work that is genuinely yours. Recent published results include 38% lower fraud losses at a top-10 European bank, OEE up 7.2 points across 14 plants at a global automotive OEM, and claims settled 55% faster at a top-5 global insurer.

blocks.sub: Eight expertise domains and a full consulting practice

blocks.x: Each domain pairs named practices with the platform they run on. Whichever door you enter, delivery follows the same rules: a named owner, a measurable result, and reporting against your own numbers. The consulting practice — transformation programs, migration factories, engineering pods, quality engineering, Azure estates, ERP cores, managed operations and end-user support — ends in delivery: the team that advises you is the team that builds it.

blocks.sub: Onsite command, offshore scale, one delivery standard

blocks.x: Our teams work as one delivery organization: engineers who plug into your teams as extra capacity, while business ownership stays on your side. The same quality checks apply on both sides, so handovers stay clean across every geography. Four global delivery centers, 24x7 operations coverage and 40+ countries served.

blocks.sub: RPA programs delivered end to end, with Automation Anywhere

items: Process analysis
We measure which processes are worth automating before anything is built.
Vision & strategy
Where robots pay for themselves first, and how the program scales from there.

24x7 managed support

blocks.sub: Every engagement starts from configured IP

blocks.x: Eight platforms, one job each: Nexus runs decisions, Forge runs data, Swarm runs agents, Sentinel guards access, Twinverse mirrors operations, Quanta readies compute, Ledger anchors trust and Compass keeps AI inspectable. Licensing is included in the engagement fee — and accelerators built specifically for you can carry co-ownership terms. The method families underneath are published in the patented-intelligence method map with their controls.

blocks.sub: Client outcomes, with the numbers left in

blocks.x: Every case study in the library states what changed, by how much, and where it ran — indexed by industry and service area, each with the delivery notes behind the number.

blocks.sub: One page, signed in week two

blocks.x: The program charter records the metric the program must move, the owner of each control, and the boundaries of acceptable risk. Your board and your auditors read the same page delivery runs on. The metric is signed as a baseline in week two and reported every fortnight; if the owner changes, the baseline is re-signed before work continues.

blocks.sub: Where we work — and the rules you answer to

blocks.x: Twelve sectors, each brief mapping the regulations, systems and workflows your programs will touch: DORA for banking, Solvency II for insurance, HIPAA and GxP for healthcare, IEC 62443 for manufacturing, NERC CIP for energy, NIS2 for telecom, PCI DSS for retail and the rest.
What we are learning on live programs — retrieval layers, decision hubs, agent guardrails and the economics of GenAI — with the questions worth asking any vendor.
Tell us the outcome you need to move. We will show you the method, the platform and the plan we would sign against it — in a 45-minute briefing with a practice lead.
